_note: Immutable archival ledger of the Delaware Beach Finds back catalog: every published story older than the current issue. Metadata only; prose lives in sourceProsePath and is pinned by sourceProseSHA256. Entries are never removed; publishedAt, date and issueId are frozen; a prose change must be recorded in revisions. issueId is null where the story was published before the issue system existed; it is never back-filled. Built by scripts/build_story_archive.py.
